answer: Latency-Banded Registration Windows: identities anchor only in timed inlet slots, and each slot admits one anchor per distinct coordination graph. Linking two identities into one task forces both into a shared slot, so the attacker pays the full wait and forfeit of a fresh lotus cycle per extra identity. Slots are sized to timber supply, capping simultaneous registrations. Cost: one full cycle delay plus forfeited slot deposit per sybil, scaling linearly with fleet size.
